# Indian Peaks Wilderness Alliance (IPWA)

> > Nonprofit organization dedicated to protecting and preserving the Indian Peaks Wilderness and James Peak Wilderness areas in Colorado through volunteer stewardship, education, and conservation advocacy.

IPWA works in partnership with the U.S. Forest Service and Boulder Ranger District to coordinate wilderness patrols, trail restoration projects, and environmental education programs. The organization mobilizes seasonal volunteers to maintain trails and educate visitors about responsible wilderness use in the Colorado Front Range.

- [IPWA | Volunteer Opportunities](https://www.indianpeakswilderness.org/volunteer-opportunities): Volunteer program for Indian Peaks & James Peaks Wilderness conservation

## Education & Outreach

- [IPWA | Teach the Teachers Program](https://www.indianpeakswilderness.org/teach-the-teacher-program): WIN program with UNC for environmental education & teacher training
